column1: # Half-remembered lines, then the refs that count, joined by "|". Never tuned against: written October 14, 2026,
# before any tuning, and scored only to report.
frailty thy name is woman
the plays the thing wherein ill catch the conscience of the king
what a piece of work is man
goodnight sweet prince and flights of angels sing you to your rest
the rest is silence
all that glitters is not gold
if you prick us do we not bleed
a plague on both your houses
but soft what light through yonder window breaks
love looks not with the eyes but with the mind
the fault dear brutus is not in our stars but in ourselves
cowards die many times before their deaths
fair is foul and foul is fair
screw your courage to the sticking place
all hail macbeth that shalt be king hereafter
how sharper than a serpents tooth it is to have a thankless child
blow winds and crack your cheeks
nothing will come of nothing
beware my lord of jealousy the green eyed monster
who steals my purse steals trash
full fathom five thy father lies
hell is empty and all the devils are here
my mistress eyes are nothing like the sun
let me not to the marriage of true minds admit impediments
this royal throne of kings this sceptered isle
journeys end in lovers meeting
discretion is the better part of valor
the evil that men do lives after them
though she be but little she is fierce
i am more sinned against than sinning
